# BrewHarbor

> Find your coffee machine. Skip the research. Independent coffee machine recommendations: a 7-question quiz plus specs, scores, strengths and watch-outs for 68 machines. No sponsored placements; Amazon links are affiliate links.

## Data
- [Machine data (JSON)](https://getbrewharbor.com/machines.json): all machines with specs, 1-5 scores and regional prices
- [Recommendation API](https://getbrewharbor.com/api/recommend): POST a quiz profile (drinks, effort, coffeeType, budget, region, priorities) and get ranked machines with reasons; GET with no parameters returns usage docs
- [All machines](https://getbrewharbor.com/machines/): browsable directory
- [Sitemap](https://getbrewharbor.com/sitemap.xml)

## Notes
- Scores are BrewHarbor's own 1-5 ratings (5 is best), the same ones used by the quiz.
- Prices are estimates; check the retailer for current prices.
- Width and brew temperature are omitted for machines whose specs are still being verified.
